CMOS dynamic latched comparator
.include "circuit.spice"
.include "models.spice"
VDD vdd 0 3.3
VP inp 0 PWL(0 1.66 20n 1.66 21n 1.64 100n 1.64)
VN inn 0 1.65
VC clk 0 PULSE(0 3.3 5n 100p 100p 8n 20n)
XDUT vdd 0 clk inp inn op on astra_019_cmos_dynamic_comparator
.temp 27
.options method=gear reltol=1e-5
* @spec positive range 3.2 3.4 unit=V
* @spec negative range -3.4 -3.2 unit=V
* @spec reset range 3.2 3.4 unit=V
* @spec delay range 1e-10 1e-9 unit=s
* @spec negative_delay range 1e-10 1e-9 unit=s
.control
set filetype=ascii
tran 20p 100n
let diff=v(on)-v(op)
let lowreset=(v(on)+v(op)-abs(v(on)-v(op)))/2
meas tran positive FIND diff AT=12n
meas tran negative FIND diff AT=32n
meas tran reset FIND lowreset AT=18n
meas tran delay TRIG v(clk) VAL=1.65 RISE=1 TARG v(op) VAL=1.65 FALL=1
meas tran negative_delay TRIG v(clk) VAL=1.65 RISE=2 TARG v(on) VAL=1.65 FALL=1
write out.raw
quit
.endc
.end
